reader_summary.headline: Business Breakdowns is exactly what it sounds like, a new series that dives deep into a single business.
reader_summary.overview: Business Breakdowns is exactly what it sounds like, a new series that dives deep into a single business. We believe that every business has secrets and lessons to learn from, and our job is to bring those to life in each episode. We started creating breakdowns last fall.

key_points.text: We tried and failed 20 times before getting one done that we were proud to publish.
key_points.evidence_quote: We tried and failed 20 times before getting one done that we were proud to publish.

key_points.text: Each breakdown requires much more than a usual conversational podcast.
key_points.evidence_quote: Each breakdown requires much more than a usual conversational podcast.

key_points.text: Each episode takes research, shaping, guest selection, and heavier editing.
key_points.evidence_quote: Each episode takes research, shaping, guest selection, and heavier editing.

key_points.text: We plan to keep honing what makes a breakdown great, and in the years to come.
key_points.evidence_quote: We plan to keep honing what makes a breakdown great, and in the years to come, we plan to break down every single interesting business in the world.
